summary: ACDT #64：gas 上限升到 75M 前需先实现并测试 getBlobsV3 与最大 blob 参数，随 BPO3 版本发布；ePBS builder 将不参与验证、质押 1 ETH；共识层升级改名 Heze。leekt 为 ERC-7780 新增模块类型 8 到 10 并合并。nero_eth 认为 FOCIL 只在少数场景有帮助。

items.title: ACDT #64
items.note: 21:00，据 Ethereal news #3：gas 上限升到 75M 前，客户端需先实现并测试 getBlobsV3 与最大 blob 参数，准备随 BPO3 版本发布；提议由客户端而非验证者设定 gas 上限；Glamsterdam 中 ePBS builder 不参与验证、质押 1 ETH；Hegotá 的共识层升级因 Heka 不在 IAU 星表中改名 Heze。
items.note_en: 21:00, per Ethereal news #3: before a 75M gas limit, clients must build and test getBlobsV3 and a max blobs flag, ready for BPO3 releases; a proposal has clients rather than validators set the gas limit; ePBS builders in Glamsterdam are non-validating with 1 ETH staked; Hegotá's consensus upgrade is renamed Heze because Heka is not in the IAU star catalog.

items.note_en: ACDT #64, 21:00, per Ethereal news #3: before a 75M gas limit, clients must build and test getBlobsV3 and a max blobs flag, ready for BPO3 releases; a proposal has clients rather than validators set the gas limit; ePBS builders in Glamsterdam are non-validating with 1 ETH staked; Hegotá's consensus upgrade is renamed Heze because Heka is not in the IAU star catalog.
